translation.name: Slow Seongsu Local Walk
translation.summary: A relaxed Seongsu route mixing Seoul Forest, a quiet cafe, local food and the neighborhood's shoe-making heritage.
translation.description: This route avoids a purely trend-focused itinerary and combines greenery, quieter cafe time, local food and Seongsu's long connection to footwear production. It suits travelers who want a slower neighborhood experience.

stops.note: Begin with a relaxed walk through Seoul Forest.
Take a quieter cafe break near Seoul Forest.
Stop for a more traditional local meal in Seongsu.
Explore the neighborhood's long-standing handmade shoe district.
Finish with a contemporary Korean footwear brand connected to Seongsu's shoe culture.
